'''''Showdown at Centerpoint''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Roger MacBride Allen]]. It is the third and final volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Corellian Trilogy]]'', and it was first published in [[September]] [[1995]] by [[Bantam Spectra]].
